Name: (DGA) Plenty of beds
Author: Stavetskaya
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][color=#f4cccc]This is a very simple DGA pack, it contains 10 single and 10 double beds available in Furniture Catalogue and buyable from the Robin's shop every day in a week except Tuesdays))) [/color]


[color=#ff0000]IMPORTANT:[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]Once you have DGA you can put the unzipped folder in your mods folder and free to use any of the items it provides.[/color]

[color=#f4cccc]It is safe to Install and Uninstall this mod in any time in your game, BUT remember to [/color][color=#ff0000]REMOVE ANY ITEMS[/color][color=#f4cccc] (Put them into a trash can you have) from your game [/color][color=#ff0000]BEFORE UNINSTALLATION![/color]

[color=#f4cccc]This should be compatible with pretty much anything so long as you have DGA. 

[/color][/size][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#d5a6bd][size=5]Mod was tested in a plain game with basic requirements and with a game contain 200+ mods. "It just works" (c)[/size]
[size=6]
[/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][color=#f4cccc][size=5]I'm not an experienced modder, heck, this is my first mod in that game, so I probably can't help you with your smapi logs or errors.[/size]
[size=6]
[/size][/color][/font][font=Comic Sans MS][size=6][color=#ff7700]REQUIREMENTS:[/color]

[color=#f4cccc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9365]Dynamic Game Assets[/url][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/color]
[color=#f4cccc][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI - Stardew Modding API[/url][/color]

[/url][/color][/size][/font][center][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5][b][color=#ff7700]Thank you for reading and attention! [/color]
[color=#f4cccc](Please, if you like it don't forget to endorse. For me it's quite important)[/color]
[color=#ff7700]Enjoy your game![/color]
